controls.name: bell_state_sign
controls.definition: Sign selecting the Psi-plus (+1) or Psi-minus (-1) Bell-state fidelity expression.

controls.name: xx_expectation
controls.definition: Measured expectation value of the two-photon Pauli XX operator.

controls.name: yy_expectation
controls.definition: Measured expectation value of the two-photon Pauli YY operator.

controls.name: zz_expectation
controls.definition: Measured expectation value of the two-photon Pauli ZZ operator.

readouts.name: bell_state_fidelity
readouts.definition: Fidelity of the generated two-photon state with the selected Psi-plus or Psi-minus Bell state.

applicability.statement: Applies to fidelities with the two Bell states Psi-minus and Psi-plus using the measured two-photon Pauli expectation values.
